purpose: Measure semantic copy-similarity and claim-support decisions beyond the deterministic Phase 10 baseline.

deidentification.method: Uses public-facing project language and synthetic evaluation text only; agent names, phone numbers, email addresses, credentials, and private campaign records are excluded.

label_policy.copy_similarity: Label meaning as distinct, related-distinct, or equivalent; action reflects cross-surface repetition risk after any explicit approved reuse.
label_policy.claim_support: Label whether the supplied excerpt supports the claim without adding unstated certainty, scope, timing, or superlatives.
label_policy.review_rule: All labels are maintainer-seeded and provisional until independent review and adjudication are recorded. Holdout cases are not used to tune questions or thresholds.
